title: A Survey of Timing Variability in Microservice-Based Software-Defined Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2608.23649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Microservice-based systems are modular and adaptable, but their distributed structure makes their timing behavior difficult to analyze and guarantee. Because latency emerges from interactions among service dependencies, shared resources, and coordinating middleware, local timing disturbances can propagate into system-level effects. This survey examines the sources, propagation mechanisms, and observable impacts of timing variability in microservice-based systems, using software-defined vehicles as a motivating example. It compares major classes of timing models by their assumptions about workload stability, execution structure, resource sharing, observability, and guarantee admissibility, and summarizes their limitations within microservice-based software-defined vehicles.

translated_title: 基于微服务的软件定义车辆中时序变异性的综述
translated_abstract: 微服务系统具有模块化和适应性强的特点，但其分布式结构使得时序行为难以分析和保证。由于延迟源于服务依赖、共享资源和协调中间件之间的交互，局部时序扰动可能传播为系统级影响。本综述以软件定义车辆为典型案例，考察了微服务系统中时序变异性的来源、传播机制和可观测影响。它通过对比主要时序模型类别在工作负载稳定性、执行结构、资源共享、可观测性和保证可接受性方面的假设，并总结了它们在基于微服务的软件定义车辆中的局限性。
tldr: 本文综述了微服务系统中时序变异性的来源、传播及影响，并以软件定义车辆为例，对比了现有时序模型的假设与局限。
en_tdlr: This survey reviews the sources, propagation, and impacts of timing variability in microservice systems, using software-defined vehicles as a case study, and compares the assumptions and limitations of existing timing models.
